description: Source code for 'luac', a Lua compiler that saves bytecodes to files and can list bytecodes. Contains main function, argument parsing, and bytecode handling logic.

methods.name: fatal
methods.description: Prints an error message and exits the program.

methods.name: cannot
methods.description: Prints an error message related to file operations and exits.

methods.name: doargs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and sets configuration flags.

methods.name: combine
methods.description: Combines multiple Lua prototypes into a single prototype.

methods.name: pmain
methods.description: Main processing function that loads files, compiles, and dumps bytecode.
